visualCharacteristics.purpose: live city information boxes (weather, air quality, traffic, mobility) with a status slot
visualCharacteristics.summary: Light-grey boxes, each an icon, a blue title link and a short line, with a slot for a live status value.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 (optional): icon image; cell 2: title link and description; cell 3 (optional): status value
contentPattern.notes: Repeating look-alike items. The live values (weather icon, air quality and traffic levels) are fed by JavaScript.

usage: Madrid al minuto: each card links to a live service. The status slot (.cards-live-info-card-status, keyed by li[data-key]) is hidden until a value is authored or set by script.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for status/dashboard style link boxes. Use cards-tiles for photo tiles.
